title: session/state
description: Notification `session/state` (daemon -> client): where one session stands, sent to EVERY initialized connection on every transition, including sessions that connection did not open. It affirms the state rather than expressing a difference, so applying it twice or applying two of them out of order converges on the last one that arrived — that is what removes the need for a sequence number and what makes the snapshot a connection receives on initialize safe to race against the first transition. A connection that falls behind is re-sent the snapshot by the daemon; a client never has to notice a gap. Nothing of the project travels here: no instruction, no title, no turn text.

sessionState.description: Lifecycle state of an agent session. `waiting_instruction` is alive and between turns, with its agent subprocess intact. `interrupted` marks a session with no recorded end (the daemon stopped mid-session).

projectRoot.description: Absolute repository root, in the same spelling `session/list` reports, so a client narrows by project without asking again.

since.description: When the session entered this state (RFC 3339, UTC). A wall clock, because a surface subtracts it to show how long the session has been working.

pendingPermissions.description: How many of this session's permission requests are waiting on a human.
